# Bundled spreadsheet libraries

These files are included locally so the scratchpad works without a network connection.

| Package | Version | Files | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Jspreadsheet CE](https://www.npmjs.com/package/jspreadsheet-ce) | 5.0.4 | `jspreadsheet-ce/` | MIT (see `jspreadsheet-ce/LICENSE`) |
| [jSuites](https://www.npmjs.com/package/jsuites) | 5.13.5 | `jsuites/` | MIT (see `jsuites/LICENSE`) |
| [Jspreadsheet Formula Basic](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@jspreadsheet/formula) | 2.0.2 | `jspreadsheet-formula/` | MIT (stated in the distribution header) |

Only the browser JavaScript and CSS assets needed by the app are copied from the npm packages.
